import os, subprocess, tempfile
cases = [
 (["*.log"], "a.log", "f"),
 (["*.log"], "sub/a.log", "f"),
 (["*.log", "!keep.log"], "keep.log", "f"),
 (["*.log", "!keep.log"], "sub/keep.log", "f"),
 (["!keep.log", "*.log"], "keep.log", "f"),
 (["build/"], "build", "d"),
 (["build/"], "build", "f"),
 (["build/"], "src/build", "d"),
 (["build/"], "build/x.txt", "f"),
 (["build/", "!build/keep.txt"], "build/keep.txt", "f"),
 (["/root.txt"], "root.txt", "f"),
 (["/root.txt"], "sub/root.txt", "f"),
 (["docs/*.tmp"], "docs/a.tmp", "f"),
 (["docs/*.tmp"], "x/docs/a.tmp", "f"),
 (["docs/*.tmp"], "docs/sub/a.tmp", "f"),
 (["**/cache"], "cache", "d"),
 (["**/cache"], "a/b/cache", "f"),
 (["a/**"], "a", "d"),
 (["a/**"], "a/b/c.txt", "f"),
 (["x/**/y"], "x/y", "f"),
 (["x/**/y"], "x/p/q/y", "f"),
 (["x/**/y"], "z/x/y", "f"),
 (["\\#hash"], "#hash", "f"),
 (["#hash"], "#hash", "f"),
 (["\\!bang"], "!bang", "f"),
 (["trail\\ "], "trail ", "f"),
 (["foo  "], "foo", "f"),
 (["f?o"], "fxo", "f"),
 (["[ab].txt"], "b.txt", "f"),
 (["sub/inner/"], "sub/inner", "d"),
 (["sub/inner/"], "x/sub/inner", "d"),
 (["*"], "anything", "f"),
 (["", "   ", "# c"], "a", "f"),
 (["!*.log"], "a.log", "f"),
 (["a/**/"], "a/b", "d"),
 (["a/**/"], "a/b", "f"),
 (["**"], "x/y", "f"),
 (["src/"], "src/a/b.txt", "f"),
 (["b"], "a/b/c.txt", "f"),
 (["/a/b"], "a/b", "d"),
]
for pats, p, kind in cases:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", d], check=True, env={"HOME": d, "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": "/dev/null", "PATH": os.environ["PATH"]})
        open(os.path.join(d, ".gitignore"), "w").write("\n".join(pats) + "\n")
        full = os.path.join(d, p)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(full), exist_ok=True)
        if kind == "d":
            os.makedirs(full, exist_ok=True); q = p + "/"
        else:
            open(full, "w").close(); q = p
        r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", d, "check-ignore", "-q", q], env={"HOME": d, "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": "/dev/null", "PATH": os.environ["PATH"]})
        print(repr(pats), repr(p), kind, r.returncode == 0)

import os, subprocess, tempfile
cases = [(["build/"], "build"), (["build/"], "src/build"), (["**/cache"], "cache"), (["a/**"], "a"), (["sub/inner/"], "sub/inner"), (["sub/inner/"], "x/sub/inner"), (["a/**/"], "a/b"), (["/a/b"], "a/b")]
for pats, p in cases:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        env = {"HOME": d, "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": "/dev/null", "PATH": os.environ["PATH"]}
        subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", d], check=True, env=env)
        open(os.path.join(d, ".gitignore"), "w").write("\n".join(pats) + "\n")
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, p))
        open(os.path.join(d, p, "f"), "w").close()
